title: strlen and strchr by Hand
hints: Stop when `*p == '\0'`. For `c_strlen`, keep the original `s` where it is and walk a copy `p` forward with `++p`.

Length is the distance between two pointers: `p - s`. That is a signed `std::ptrdiff_t`, so cast it: `static_cast<std::size_t>(p - s)`. For `find_char`, test for `c` *before* testing for the terminator, or `'\0'` can never be found.
